name: Cabozantinib (RAI-refractory DTC, after prior VEGFR therapy)
cyclesNote: continuous daily dosing until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; not a fixed cycle count

institution.provenance: ONCOTREE draft protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

histology: radioiodine-refractory differentiated thyroid carcinoma progressing after prior VEGFR-directed therapy
supportiveCare: hold before and after surgery given impaired wound healing; watch for GI perforation / fistula and hemorrhage.
monitor for hypertension, diarrhea, hand-foot skin reaction, and fatigue.
take on an empty stomach (no food 2 hours before and 1 hour after); continue TSH suppression.
reserve for progressive disease after a prior multikinase inhibitor.
monitoring: signs of bleeding or GI perforation / fistula

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 to 4 toxicity or GI perforation / significant hemorrhage
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt and resume at a reduced dose (typical reductions 40 mg, then 20 mg daily); discontinue for perforation / fistula or serious hemorrhage. Obtain clinical review. Physician decides.

drugs.name: Cabozantinib
drugs.notes: Cabozantinib (tablet, Cabometyx form) 60 mg PO once daily on an empty stomach, continuous until progression or unacceptable toxicity, is the standard dose for radioiodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer after prior VEGFR-targeted therapy (per standard guidelines, general reference; COSMIC-311 dose).
